text:
emma: Quick company-wide note: Hosted Toolkit is GA as of today. This unifies streaming + tool-calling into a single supported surface for hosted customers. Please read the short migration checklist below. :tada:

raj: Congrats team! Where's the doc?

emma: Internal docs & migration: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted-toolkit-ga (SSO). Key highlights in this thread.

lia: Ops summary: new canonical API path is `/v1/hosted/toolkit` and supports SSE + chunked JSON frames. We added a request header `X-Toolkit-Mode` to toggle strict tool validation (off by default). Backwards compatibility: old beta paths proxied and will be retired after a 120-day migration window.

raj: SDKs? Any forced upgrades?

emma: JS & Python SDKs published as v1.8.2 with a `ToolkitClient`. Not strictly required for basic calls, but recommended for correct streaming/tool-call framing.

lia: Support notes: Canary started at 6% of traffic; dashboards (Hosted Toolkit GA) are live. If you see unexpected sync fallbacks or 5xx spikes, tag #incidents and page oncall. We've added automated alerts for sudden increases in synchronous fallbacks.

raj: Rate limits?

lia: Default quotas unchanged. Toolkit routes report per-route QPS and token usage. Dedicated customers can request dedicated pool pinning via Account Ops.

emma: Migration checklist for teams: 1) Update public docs links. 2) Encourage customers to upgrade SDKs. 3) Monitor GA dashboard for P95/P99 for first 72h. 4) Use `X-Toolkit-Mode: strict` only after testing.

lia: Release bot: release/hosted-toolkit-ga -> production succeeded at 2026-03-24T09:30:00Z :white_check_mark:

emma: We'll run a short demo + Q&A at 12:00 PT; recording will be available. Thanks to everyone who shipped this! :partyparrot:
